verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is fundamentally an API/webhook-driven platform: cards are created, managed, and authorized entirely via REST calls and relayed-authorization webhooks with no required UI, and Adyen even documents forcing verification-error scenarios for automated testing (docs-12), which supports CI-style automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, SDK-based automation scripts, or documented headless test harnesses beyond the verification-error simulation.
